name: RLHF/RLAIF Alignment Implementation
description: Program delivery structured around RLHF/RLAIF rollout per docs/rlhf_rlaif_strategy.md

children.name: Stage 0 – Team Mobilization & Audit
children.description: Mobilize core leadership and audit current processes as per implementation plan stage 0.

children.name: Assemble cross-functional RLHF/RLAIF task force
children.description: Identify and confirm cross-functional leaders aligned to Stage 0 objectives.

children.name: Audit existing alignment and compliance workflows
children.description: Review current processes to baseline RLHF/RLAIF governance gaps.

children.name: Stage 1 – Annotation Foundations
children.description: Build instructional assets, templates, and QA controls for annotation operations.

children.name: Author RLHF Annotation Guide v1
children.description: Draft the core guide covering goals, inputs, categories, and policies.

children.name: Localize and security-review bilingual instructions
children.description: Apply Ukrainian/English localization and compliance reviews to the guide.

children.name: Implement annotation templates and schema validation
children.description: Deliver Jinja2 templates and YAML schema validation for annotation records.

children.name: Launch annotation quality measurement controls
children.description: Operationalize weekly agreement metrics and sampling audits for annotations.

children.name: Stage 2 – Reward Systems & Data Engines
children.description: Stand up evaluators, active learning, self-critique, reward, safety, and simulators.

children.name: Deploy multi-tier evaluator stack
children.description: Implement automated, junior, senior, committee, and RLAIF evaluator layers.

children.name: Build active data selection workflows
children.description: Integrate uncertainty, diversity, and business-prior sampling loops.

children.name: Operationalize model self-reflection logging
children.description: Enable self-critique stage and capture outputs in knowledge graph for analysis.

children.name: Design reward function and penalty governance
children.description: Implement weighted reward function with penalty components and adaptive weights.

children.name: Enforce constrained safety policies
children.description: Codify machine-readable policies and integrate constrained RL methods with pre-train analysis.

children.name: Develop user simulators portfolio
children.description: Deliver behavioral models, rare-event scripts, and parameterized market simulators.

children.name: Stage 3 – Learning Operations & Safety Gates
children.description: Integrate pipelines, scorecards, alerts, and deployment safety workflows.

children.name: Orchestrate RLHF pipeline stages
children.description: Automate data curation, SFT, reward training, RL optimization, evaluation, and deployment gate.

children.name: Calibrate and explain RLAIF evaluators
children.description: Integrate AI evaluators with calibration, disagreement sampling, and explainability reports.

children.name: Publish scorecards and automated alerts
children.description: Deploy human, alignment, and safety scorecards with alerting integrations.

children.name: Implement pre-deployment assurance gates
children.description: Run checklist, red teaming, shadow deployment, and rollback readiness gates.

children.name: Stage 4 – Continuous Assurance & Governance
children.description: Maintain regression safeguards, MLOps governance, audits, and changelog discipline.

children.name: Execute regression safeguard suites
children.description: Maintain data, reward, policy, and simulator regression testing cadence.

children.name: Operate MLOps governance and audits
children.description: Run MLOps pipeline, DVC/MLflow versioning, and quarterly independent audits.

children.name: Maintain alignment changelog and release governance
children.description: Publish updates to alignment changelog with release tags and approvals.
